name: session-status
description: One row of status dots above the prompt, in Catppuccin (Latte on light, Macchiato on dark): on desktop the row is one SVG with a rounded capsule, a colored dot per segment and small progress bars; on the terminal, text dots and text bars. Work item (its Azure DevOps title on hover), git branch, active-time timer and subagent counts, then context (token count on hover) and CPU/RAM/temperature (Windows only); plus a session title with the work item title (needs the Azure CLI, read-only)
